name: Select informative evidence
when: The current observations support more than one spatial interpretation.
preconditions: Use only observations and inspection operations permitted by this task.
procedure: State which uncertainty prevents the next decision: identity, position, orientation or visibility.
Compare the supplied views that best distinguish the alternatives; request an additional current-scene view only when the interface permits it.
Use new evidence to revise the interpretation before repeating the same edit.
verification: The selected evidence addresses the stated uncertainty.
failure_lessons: A new render of the constructed scene is not a new observation of a hidden reference target.
adaptation_notes: Adapts Multi-view Verification & Occlusion and Comprehensive Scene Understanding; does not require Pi3.
